activity.notes: Antônio Conselheiro and his followers settled at Canudos in Bahia in 1893 and developed the community known by them as Belo Monte. ATLAS uses the autonomous Belo Monte/Canudos community rather than the broad geographic term Sertão, which is a region rather than a polity or political community.

sources.title: Casa de Antonio Conselheiro — Sobre
sources.citation_text: The Ceará cultural institution states that Conselheiro and his large following settled in Canudos in 1893, developing the community project of Belo Monte before its destruction in 1897.
